run_dump_loader_load: run DumpLoader.load to retrieve a tensor dump by name, step, and optional kwargs from a dump directory
build_read_meta_from_directory: build a Polars DataFrame of metadata from all .pt files in a dump directory using read_meta
parse_meta_from_filename: parse key=value metadata pairs from a filename stem using parse_meta_from_filename
test_ValueWithMeta_load: test ValueWithMeta.load to extract both tensor value and embedded metadata from a .pt file
find_row_in_dump_metadata: find a matching row in the dump metadata DataFrame by name, step, rank, and dump_index conditions
